title: [3.0-beta7] AAPS didnt update 'x min ago' with new BG reading being same as prior one
symptom: In AAPS 3.0-beta7, the 'x min ago' timestamp does not update when a new BG reading is the same as the previous one. The screen shows '8 min ago' while xDrip shows '2 min ago', indicating the reading was delivered but AAPS did not update the timestamp.
evidence_quote: 3.0-beta7 doesnt update 'x min ago' when no change in BG Screen shows "8 min ago" at phone timestamp 00:11,. Xdrip at same time was showing 2 min ago and I've been debugging why its reading wasnt delivered to AAPS. It seems it was actually delivered, but AAPS didnt update the "min ago" timestamp.
